2429: def silu(input: Tensor, inplace: bool = False) -> Tensor:
2430:     r"""Apply the Sigmoid Linear Unit (SiLU) function, element-wise.
2431: 
2432:     The SiLU function is also known as the swish function.
2433: 
2434:     .. math::
2435:         \text{silu}(x) = x * \sigma(x), \text{where } \sigma(x) \text{ is the logistic sigmoid.}
2436: 
2437:     .. note::
2438:         See `Gaussian Error Linear Units (GELUs) <https://arxiv.org/abs/1606.08415>`_
2439:         where the SiLU (Sigmoid Linear Unit) was originally coined, and see
2440:         `Sigmoid-Weighted Linear Units for Neural Network Function Approximation
2441:         in Reinforcement Learning <https://arxiv.org/abs/1702.03118>`_ and `Swish:
2442:         a Self-Gated Activation Function <https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.05941v1>`_
2443:         where the SiLU was experimented with later.
2444: 
2445:     See :class:`~torch.nn.SiLU` for more details.
2446:     """
2447:     if has_torch_function_unary(input):
2448:         return handle_torch_function(silu, (input,), input, inplace=inplace)
2449:     if inplace:
2450:         return torch._C._nn.silu_(input)
2451:     return torch._C._nn.silu(input)

54:     r"""Applies an affine linear transformation to the incoming data: :math:`y = xA^T + b`.
55:

58:     On certain ROCm devices, when using float16 inputs this module will use :ref:`different precision<fp16_on_mi200>` for backward.
59: 
60:     Args:

64:             Default: ``True``
65: 
66:     Shape:
67:         - Input: :math:`(*, H_\text{in})` where :math:`*` means any number of
68:           dimensions including none and :math:`H_\text{in} = \text{in\_features}`.
69:         - Output: :math:`(*, H_\text{out})` where all but the last dimension
70:           are the same shape as the input and :math:`H_\text{out} = \text{out\_features}`.
71: 
72:     Attributes:
73:         weight: the learnable weights of the module of shape
74:             :math:`(\text{out\_features}, \text{in\_features})`. The values are

76:             :math:`k = \frac{1}{\text{in\_features}}`
77:         bias:   the learnable bias of the module of shape :math:`(\text{out\_features})`.
78:                 If :attr:`bias` is ``True``, the values are initialized from
79:                 :math:`\mathcal{U}(-\sqrt{k}, \sqrt{k})` where
80:                 :math:`k = \frac{1}{\text{in\_features}}`
81: 
82:     Examples::
83: 
84:         >>> m = nn.Linear(20, 30)
85:         >>> input = torch.randn(128, 20)
86:         >>> output = m(input)
